title: Central Station Lost 100 Minutes 17 Years Ago | ECHO//30 Ep. 4
description:
Rhea confiscates the dead phone and admits Central Station lost one hundred minutes seventeen years ago—but she still refuses to tell Kavi what happened to his father.

When Kavi, Tara, and Byte reach the sealed platform, the Red Door demands an exchange. Then a voice Rhea knows speaks from the other side.
